Name: Windowed Event Count
Description__c: Count events for an Account in a trailing window.

Name: Windowed Event Rate
Description__c: Rate of events meeting a condition.

Name: Duration Summary
Description__c: Summary of elapsed-time values; include robust/tail summaries.

Name: Recency
Description__c: Days since most recent relevant event.

Name: Interaction Frequency
Description__c: Interaction frequency over a trailing window.

Name: Trend Delta
Description__c: Change between recent and prior windows.

Name: Variability
Description__c: Dispersion/consistency of a measure.

Name: Threshold Violation Rate
Description__c: Share exceeding a threshold or violating a commitment.

Name: State Share
Description__c: Share of records in a business state.

Name: Ratio
Description__c: Ratio between related quantities.

Name: Breadth
Description__c: Distinct products, people, roles, channels, or capabilities represented.

Name: Concentration
Description__c: Degree to which activity/value is concentrated in one category.

Name: Transition Rate
Description__c: Frequency of state/owner/team transitions.

Name: First-Time-Right Rate
Description__c: Share completed without reopen/rework/repeat contact.

Name: Profile Passthrough
Description__c: Stable Account attribute used directly as a profile feature.

Name: Profile Numeric Band
Description__c: Numeric/currency Account attribute converted to a cohort-friendly band.

Name: Customer Tenure
Description__c: Customer tenure derived from a customer-since/start date.

Name: Customer Tenure Band
Description__c: Cohort-friendly band derived from customer tenure.

Name: Categorical Cohort Dimension
Description__c: Categorical Account attribute used as a peer-cohort dimension when cardinality is appropriate.

Name: Cohort Delta
Description__c: Difference between an Account Direct Experience Feature and its cohort benchmark.

Name: Cohort Ratio
Description__c: Ratio of an Account Direct Experience Feature to its cohort benchmark.

Name: Cohort Percentile
Description__c: Peer percentile for an Account Direct Experience Feature.

Name: Cohort Z-Score
Description__c: Standardized distance from the peer cohort when statistically appropriate.
